Standards, Policies & Guides

Standards, Policies & Guides

 

Find OIT’s current requirements, follow proposed rule changes and respond to drafts. Rules are official regulations; policies set statewide expectations; technical standards and mandatory procedures describe how to meet them. Technology Direction guides this work.
